messages:
Jordan (AE): Heads-up — Databank wants IAM artifacts for Dedicated POC: SAML IdP/SP metadata, MFA enforcement proof, RBAC mappings, and least-privilege notes. They want it by EOD Friday.
Maria (Security): I can own the artifacts. Confirming scope: Dedicated primarily, but they asked about Hosted parity. We'll mark differences.
Jordan (AE): Dedicated trial, but also parity notes for Hosted.
Maria (Security): Deliverables plan:
 - SAML metadata export (SP metadata redacted for ACS/EntityID placeholders)
 - MFA policy screenshot (Console) + redacted auth-log sample (success/fail counts, example events)
 - RBAC mapping CSV (role_name,allowed_actions,resource_scope) with customer identifiers removed
 - One-paragraph least-privilege rationale per default role
Sam (Eng): I'll extract a 24h slice from prod-auth-log and redact userids (sha256). Query: index=auth-prod sourcetype=auth:events earliest=-24h | fields timestamp,event_type,user_id,status,method | eval user_id=sha256(user_id)
Sam (Eng): Example redacted event (included as a snippet):
```
{ event_type: 'mfa_challenge', user_hash: 'b1946ac92492d2347c6235b4d2611184', status: 'success', method: 'totp', timestamp: '2026-03-18T14:22:33Z' }
```
Sam (Eng): I'll also produce a CSV with totals: total_auths,mfa_required_count,mfa_success_count,mfa_fail_count for the window.
Devin (Solutions): I'll produce role_mapping.csv. Sample rows:
support,Read-only support,read:list|read:get,customer/*,No write perms
ops,Token ops,create:token|delete:token,cluster:prod-us-east,Scoped to cluster IDs only
Devin (Solutions): I'll add 'least_privilege_rationale' for each role.
Maria (Security): For SAML metadata, export SP metadata from Console then replace ACS/EntityID with placeholders and add the note: 'redacted - full values available under NDA/DPA for Dedicated deployments.'
Jordan (AE): Do we have a standard redaction checklist to attach? They push for minimal redaction.
Maria (Security): Use security/templates/redaction-guidelines.md. Include MD5 checksum of original file and a list of fields redacted. Offer full artifacts under NDA/SOW.
AuditBot: Scan of redaction-guidelines.md complete — no flags. https://internal.redwood/sec-scans/5678 :white_check_mark:
Jordan (AE): Delivery plan: Jordan will upload redaction-pack + attestation to prospect by EOD Friday to the sales folder. Please upload final files to https://redwoodcompany.box.com/sales-evidence/Databank-1772 (folder 'Databank-Dedicated') and ping Maria for sign-off.
Sam (Eng): ETA: logs + sample JSON in ~4 hours.
Devin (Solutions): ETA: RBAC CSV + rationales in ~3 hours, will hand to Maria for sign-off.
Maria (Security): I'll sign off once artifacts are in the dropbox. Include SIG/CAIQ mapping for IAM rows (IAM-1 SSO, IAM-2 MFA, IAM-3 RBAC) in a one-pager.
Jordan (AE): Thanks team. I'll escalate if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
